title: QUANT PHYSIOLOGY II:ORGAN SYST
description: Beginning with biological issues related to the cell, the course progresses to considerations of the major physiological systems of the human body (nervous, circulatory, respiratory, renal)
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( BIOL UN2005 ) and ( BIOL UN2006 ) BIOL C2005 AND BIOL C2006; BMEN E3020 AND BMEN E3820 OR BMEN E3020 OR BMEN E4490 OR BMEN E6505 Corequisites: BMEN E3020 , BMEN E3820 Students are introduced to a quantitative, engineering approach to cellular biology and mammalian physiology.
